description: This file defines layout components for a social media frontend application, including Sidebar, Topbar, and Layout components. It imports React, routing components, and a custom session context, and exports these UI components for use in the application.

methods.name: Sidebar()
methods.description: A functional component rendering the sidebar navigation, including links to analytics, profile, and admin pages.

methods.name: Topbar()
methods.description: A functional component displaying engagement insights header and user info, retrieving selectedUserId from session context.

methods.name: Layout({ children })
methods.description: A higher-level layout component composing Sidebar and Topbar with a main content area.
